title: Gölgeler Çekildiğinde
author: Cahide Birgül
description: Esin lives alone with his ailing father, until an uninvited guest disrupts their fragile world. As this stranger gradually infiltrates his life, Esin is forced to confront haunting ghosts from his troubled past. In her debut novel, Birgül makes the uncanny her protagonist, creating a chilling story that strips bare loneliness, trauma, and the fragility of the so-called safe haven of “home.”
